reporting_rule_for_me: when this fails, re-run and record BOTH outcomes rather than quoting only the passing one. A suite count I report as passing must be the count I actually observed, not the one I got on the retry.
what_happened: it FAILED once during this cycle and passed on the three immediately following runs of the same suite.
why_it_is_not_a_defect: the test draws 10,000 coins from os.urandom and asserts the count of ones lies in [4850, 5150]. Binomial(10000, 0.5) has sd = 50, so that band is exactly +/- 3 sd and the two-sided tail probability is 0.0027 -- about ONE FAILURE IN EVERY 370 RUNS, by construction. Its own docstring says "Stochastic by construction."
why_no_action: widening the band would weaken a deliberate plumbing self-test of protocol 4.3 to make a suite look cleaner, and seeding the draw would destroy the thing being tested -- that os.urandom is actually producing balanced bits. A test that fails 1 in 370 times BECAUSE THE WORLD IS RANDOM is behaving correctly. What would be wrong is reporting a green suite without saying this run was not green.
